rationale: C01 is a highly plausible drafting template. It is an earlier resignation-acceptance letter for the same office and shares an unusually concentrated set of language and structure with the child: reluctant acceptance, service described as both varied and distinguished, praise for foresight and vision, the exact statement that the official discharged his duties “well and faithfully,” discussion of national security, and concluding gratitude. C21 and C24 are also close Secretary of Defense resignation letters, but their verbal overlap is less distinctive and extensive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your services in positions of great responsibility have been as varied as they have been distinguished.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your service to your country covering a period of almost nine years ... has been as varied as it has been distinguished.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim appraisal language strongly indicates reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You have discharged your duties well and faithfully.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: You discharged all these duties well and faithfully.
shared_material.explanation: The operative commendation is essentially identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your foresight and initiative earned your colleagues' respect
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your entire service has been characterized by vision, foresight
shared_material.explanation: Both emphasize foresight and vision as defining qualities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your contribution to the national security places me and every other American in your debt.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the work of enhancing the national security ... heartfelt assurance of my gratitude and appreciation
shared_material.explanation: Both connect the departing Defense Secretary's work to national security and national gratitude.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I accept your resignation as Secretary of Defense ... I do this with regret.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I accept your resignation ... Although I take this action reluctantly
shared_material.explanation: The letters use the same resignation-acceptance framework, adapted to different effective dates and circumstances.
